title: DeviceChain command response
description: The JSON message a device publishes on MQTT topic {instanceId}/{tenant}/command-responses/{deviceToken} to report the outcome of a command it was delivered. The responding device is taken from the topic, never from the body. A message that is not valid JSON, or whose members have the wrong types (for example a quoted success), cannot be matched to a command: it is recorded on the dead-letters stream with reason unprocessable, naming the responding device, and unless the device answers again the command stays SENT until it times out. Required describes what a device must send: an omitted success reads as false, and an omitted commandToken matches no command.

commandToken.description: The token member of the delivery being answered: the command's token, not the device's.

success.description: true settles the command as SUCCESSFUL, false as FAILED. Omitted, it reads as false.

payload.description: The command's result data: any JSON value (a string, an object, an array, a number or a boolean), stored with the command and returned by the API. A string is stored as its text; any other value is stored as that JSON value, exactly as sent. Omitted or null, the command has no response payload.

error.description: Why the command failed. Stored only when success is false; ignored when success is true.

dispatchNonce.description: The dispatchNonce of the delivery being answered. A response without one, or with a nonce from a dispatch the command has moved off, does not settle the command and is dead-lettered.
